errors.evidence: The chart data ends in 2021Q4, not 2024.
The phrasing 'четвърти trimestre (Q)' (fourth trimester) is an incorrect and awkward translation for 'quarter'. It implies every data point is a fourth quarter, which is not true.

errors.text_span: Основните стойности на оста X са 2003Q1 и 2024Q1, които са съответно 360 и 610.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns Y-axis values (360 and 610, which are themselves incorrect) to X-axis labels. It confuses the two axes and hallucinates the end date and values.
The chart does not specify the units for the Y-axis. Stating that the values are 'in hundreds' is an assumption not explicitly supported by the visual information.
The line in the chart is blue, not black.
The line begins at approximately 500 in 2003Q1, not 360.
The first minimum value, around 2008Q4-2009Q1, is clearly below 200 (approximately 180), not 290.
The peak of unemployment after 2009 occurs around 2013, not 2015Q1.
The second major minimum occurs around 2019Q2 at a value of approximately 130. The point in 2021Q4 is the end of the data series, not the minimum, and its value is closer to 150, not 170.

errors.text_span: след което се покачва до над 200 през 2024Q1
errors.evidence: The chart provides no data beyond 2021Q4. This trend and data point for 2024Q1 are completely fabricated.
